entries.en: Someone had sketched a hand-drawn diagram of the perimeter of the Federal Reserve military base in its northwestern part. According to the notes, there is a gap in the minefield that could be used for a safe exfil.

entries.en: Someone was preparing to assault the water treatment plant and had marked out the optimal routes to bypass the minefields. One of the routes goes toward the bay. Looks like there's a safe exfil route from the coast.
entries.zh: 看起来有人打算突袭污水处理厂，并且在行动路线图上标出了绕开雷区的最佳路线。其中一条通向海边，似乎是一条从海岸方向撤离的安全通路。

entries.en: Someone has hand-drawn a diagram of the minefield next to the railroad in the nature reserve area. Apparently, you can safely exfil from Priozersk near the railroad bridge.
entries.zh: 有人手绘了一张自然保护区内铁路调车场旁的雷区地图，显然，有这张地图做参照就可以从铁路桥旁安全撤离Priozersky保护区。

entries.en: It seems that "Voron" is some kind of cipher or code. If someone has manipulated the exfils from Customs, they must have left access only for their own. The question is, where are these exits?
entries.zh: 显然，“Voron”是某种暗号或者密码。如果有人控制着从海关撤离的路线，他们必然为自己预留了专门的后路。但问题是，这些神秘的撤离点在哪呢？

entries.en: “Onyx”. If it's not a random scribble, then it's some kind of code. Perhaps one of the Scavs has found a new exfil route out of the city, but only allows access to their own. In a densely built environment, a reliable escape route must be underground.
entries.zh: “Onyx”？如果这不是什么随手乱写的涂鸦的话，那八成是某种暗号了。也许有哪个Scav找到了逃离市区的新通路，但决定秘而不宣只让自己人通过。在街区这样高楼密布的环境下，唯一可靠的路线只有通过地下逃脱了。

entries.en: There's only one word on the note: “Adaptation”. Looks like a code word. If someone found a new exfil route out of the TerraGroup HQ area, they must have placed their men nearby to keep anyone from the outside from getting to the new exit. In that case, the code would help distinguish friend from foe.
entries.zh: 纸条上只写着一个词“Adaptation”，应该是某种密码。如果真的有人找到了逃离TerraGroup总部大楼所在地新的路线，那他们一定会在路线周围派人严加把守，防止外人走漏消息。也就是说，只有拿着密码纸条的人才能通过。

entries.en: The word “Ark” hardly needs to be taken literally. It's more like a code word. There are quite a few locked doors under the Polikhim Factory, leading deeper into the catacombs. Perhaps someone will open the door for you if you know the code word.
entries.zh: 似乎没有必要解读纸条上写的“Ark”到底是什么意思，显然更接近某种密码或者暗号。Polikhim化工厂的地下通道内有不少上锁的门，通向错综复杂的地道网络。如果报出正确的暗号，说不定会有人开门放行。

entries.en: Someone wrote the word “Heartbeat” on a torn piece of paper. Sounds like one of Sanitar's weird pranks. Or perhaps a code word? If his men have their own exfil routes off Shoreline, they must be using a system of key phrases or signals. Maybe this note will make you look like one of their own.
entries.zh: 有人在随手撕下的纸条上写了“Heartbeat”这个词，听起来像是Sanitar会有的那种恶趣味。还是说，这其实是个暗号？如果这帮人开辟了进出海岸线的专属通道，那么他们一定会采用某种暗语信号来表明敌我。这张纸条也许能让你蒙混过关。

entries.en: A key to one of the rooms in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk forest. It is said that a person nicknamed Ogryzok used to trade in these parts. He used to sell rare goods including even a steady supply of tank batteries. Yet nothing had long been heard of Ogryzok, and no one knows where he had disappeared to.

entries.en: The conflict had barely started when Fence began setting up anonymous outlets for buying and selling goods. Keeping incognito, he nevertheless managed to put together a well-organised smuggler network, operating all over the Norvinsk region.
entries.zh: 早在冲突爆发前，Fence 就已经建立了自己的地下商业网络。尽管他一直隐姓埋名，但还是成功建立了这个组织严密的走私网络，影响力辐射整个诺文斯克地区。

entries.en: Previously a port zone customs terminal employee, who initially oversaw dealings of the terminal's goods. Over the course of the conflict, he put together a gang of thugs in order to grab everything of value that he could lay his hands on in the vicinity of the terminal.
entries.zh: 前港口区海关站点员工，最初负责监管站内货物往来。冲突期间，他组织了一帮人马试图将自己的势力扩大到整个海关地区，不遗余力地攫取一切利益。

entries.en: UN peacekeeping Force supply officer, based in one of the central checkpoints leading to the Tarkov port zone. The blue helmets have been seen poking their heads into small deals from the very beginning of the conflict, buying everything of value in exchange for western weapons, ammo, and all kinds of military equipment.
entries.zh: 联合维和部队后勤军官，驻扎于某个通往塔科夫港口区的主要检查站。蓝盔们从一开始就涉及了许多地下交易，用西方武器、弹药还有各式各样的军事装备来换取值钱的物品。

entries.en: A former chemical plant foreman, who from the very beginning of the conflict took to weapon modification, repairs, and maintenance of complex equipment and technology. He prefers clandestine solo living and operates discreetly, while placing complicated and challenging tasks above all else.
entries.zh: 前化工厂工头，自从冲突爆发起他就开始为双方提供武器改造与维修服务，此外还承接复杂设备与技术装置的保养工作。比起拉帮结派，他更喜欢独处、谨慎行事，对于他来说，解决复杂挑战带来的成就感胜过一切。

entries.en: Previously, he worked as a director in a shopping center located in the suburbs of Tarkov. Now dealing in mostly clothing- and gear-related items, anywhere from sunglasses to body armor.
entries.zh: 他曾在塔科夫郊区的一座大型购物中心担任主管。现在则主要经手各类服饰与护甲，商品门类从墨镜到防弹衣几乎无所不包。

entries.en: Before the conflict, he worked as a hunter in the Priozersk Natural Reserve under the State Hunting Service. A professional hunter and survival specialist. Even now, he still guards the reserve's hunting grounds from various aggressive individuals.
entries.zh: 冲突爆发前，Jaeger 是 Priozersky 自然保护区的一位猎人，效力于特区狩猎管理局。他是专业的猎手，也是生存专家﻿。即使在冲突爆发后，他还是一如既往地守卫他的狩猎场地，将不怀好意的人们驱逐出去。
